purpose: Bounded paired writer-input normalization mechanism test on frozen training families.

model.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
model.hidden_source: base-only native output_layer input after the final HC mixer

writer_input.rmsnorm_axis: last dimension, independently for each token
writer_input.application_point: before writer right-window and pooled evidence features
writer_input.log_rms_scope: Deferred; not introduced in this normalization-only comparison.

writer.reader_graph_strategy: validated native query leaf-gradient bridge plus writer trajectory VJP
writer.alpha_clock: advance once per nonempty new-evidence block; no advance for prefix, padding or query

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.trainable_parameters: native writer parameters only; fixed alpha and target_scale buffers excluded
optimizer.accumulation: 12 sequential one-sample microbatches per arm optimizer step
optimizer.clip_and_step_frequency: once after all 12 microbatches and validated TP gradient reduction
optimizer.source_policy: inherit M1 AdamW lr, weight decay, gradient clip and seed; explicit default betas and epsilon

data.selection_order: within source sort by selection_hash then group_id; retain frozen selected document/event
data.optimizer_sample_order: source_order, then within-source family rank; repeat the same order for all steps and arms
data.sample_role_binding_hash_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON, ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=false; object fields listed in sample_role_binding_hash_fields

event.history: entire first article in frozen chronological order
event.history_chunk_prefix: the same article's tokens [max(0, 512*j-128), 512*j); empty at j=0
event.article_boundary: reset local textual prefix and n-gram context; retain this event's owner memory

tensor_layout.owner_ids: nonnegative int64 [1], fresh state namespace per sample
tensor_layout.encoder_valid_mask: bool [1,T], true for real prefix and new content; false for right padding
tensor_layout.adapter_evidence_capture_valid_mask: write_mask, so physical-row capture and T0 statistics select only new tokens; evidence mode still forwards unchanged base embeddings for every input token
tensor_layout.write_mask: bool [1,T], true only for new history content; false for prefix and padding
tensor_layout.evidence_labels: none; evidence-only forward has no language loss
tensor_layout.query_labels: already shifted to prediction positions; -100 outside the 128 target positions
tensor_layout.position_ids: local arange(T) for each separate input frame
tensor_layout.attention: native causal mask; no real token may attend to right padding
tensor_layout.statistics_mask: new-token write_mask only, never encoder_valid_mask alone
tensor_layout.last_H_reassembly: concatenate SP token slices in TP-rank order; do not average channels or count TP copies twice
tensor_layout.query_autograd_mode: torch.enable_grad for every query forward, including empty, baseline, finite difference, initial perturbation and held-out probe; requires-grad leaf state where applicable. Backward may be omitted, but the native numerical forward path must match training.
tensor_layout.evidence_autograd_mode: torch.no_grad; frozen base-only reader with labels=None

scale_calibration.source_samples: training family ranks 0 and 1, exactly 12 samples
scale_calibration.evidence_frames: the same complete history frames later used by this short test
scale_calibration.base_rows: effective native BF16 T0 rows on actual new-token write events; apply dequantization scales only if a future explicitly registered quantized runtime requires them
scale_calibration.raw_targets: same seed-17 writer with unit target_scale, computed separately for none and rmsnorm
scale_calibration.aggregation: per-head sum of squared elements divided by per-head element count, then square root; repeated events count by frequency
scale_calibration.zero_or_nonfinite_denominator: stop; do not clamp away or replace the observation
scale_calibration.input_cost_accounting: record new, prefix, padded and total forwarded tokens independently from target access
scale_calibration.scale_rounding: float64(rho * T0_RMS_h / raw_target_RMS_mode_h), then one IEEE-754 binary32 cast for the fixed writer buffer.
scale_calibration.interpretation: 1% initial target RMS on the calibration write-event distribution; not a guarantee on D1 state magnitude or reader loss perturbation

initial_perturbation.source_samples: training family rank 0 of each source, exactly 6 samples
initial_perturbation.failed_candidate_action: stop and diagnose; no automatic second rho or expanded candidate search

probe.probe_memory: rebuild from fresh empty memory using that arm's writer checkpoint and complete registered history

budgets.uncertain_interrupted_consumption: charge all dispatched targets conservatively; never reset the ledger on restart
budgets.prior_ledger_scope: known launch attempts: initial reader preflight 33 plus two inconclusive norm-attached leaf TP finite-difference attempts of 220 each; root must bind authoritative shared ledger
budgets.remaining_retry_or_small_validation_targ: original reserve before adding the 220 consumed, 220 repair reserve and 1408 writer-FD reserve; do not treat this number as currently unspent
budgets.repair_exhaustion_rule: If the authorized leaf-TP repair is inconclusive, do not start paired training or add another probe. Any further diagnostic allocation needs an explicit revised registration within the unchanged global 100000 cap.

separate_interface_audit.scope: user-requested same-batch grad/no-grad logits and loss audit
separate_interface_audit.ledger: global native diagnostic cap 100000, separate from normshort cap 75000

analysis.within_alpha_norm_contrast: learning_gain(rmsnorm) - learning_gain(none), paired by frozen sample_id
secondary_metrics: L_self and delta_empty at steps 0, 4 and 8
pre-clip gradient L2 norm, clipping incidence and nonfinite count
per-head raw-target, scaled-target, D1-delta and dequantized-T0 RMS
beta mean, quantiles and fractions beta<0.01 and beta>0.99
writer parameter change norm and nonzero gradient coverage
GPU time, input tokens, target accesses and peak memory
analysis.aggregation: per source plus overall; 2 probe families per source and 128 targets per family give equal source weight

cpu_paired_family_bootstrap.resampling: within each source, sample its 2 families with replacement; preserve pairing across arms and checkpoints
cpu_paired_family_bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive uncertainty for 12 fixed training-side families, not an independent benchmark result

analysis.inconclusive_action: report inconclusive; no unregistered extra steps, sample replacement, rho search or DEV64/FINAL selection
analysis.alpha_scope: ordinary single-history-block samples cannot isolate decay effects from an initially empty state; multi-block event histories can
analysis.formal_pilot_scope: this 512-to-128 mechanism test does not replace the registered complete 8/16-block or full-event pilot
analysis.default_preference_basis: User preference recorded before paired results: parameter-free RMSNorm aligns the writer input condition with the small model post-final-norm features at low cost; the four-arm test checks side effects and has not declared a winner.

runtime.reader_loss_denominator: explicit group_total_target_tokens=1536 during each arm optimizer step
runtime.tp_policy_candidate_requirement: Both current leaf-Delta TP attempts were inconclusive. Candidate launch requires a subsequently accepted and explicitly registered scaling validation receipt for the same numerical path; no guessed reduction or unregistered additional FD is allowed.

freeze.numeric_design_approval_scope: 4 arms, sample split, exact frames, epsilon, M1 optimizer core values and 75000 target cap
required_before_any_optimizer_update: fixed six-family initial perturbation PASS receipt saved
registered full-writer BPTT finite-difference PASS receipt saved
same accepted leaf-TP scaling policy remains valid for the numerical runtime
immutable FROZEN_EXECUTABLE registration links candidate and all PASS receipts
all scheduled remaining target accesses reserved within both caps
freeze.missing_fields_action: reject candidate launch while required candidate fields are missing; in a bound candidate, execute only fixed diagnostics; reject optimizer until immutable executable registration exists
freeze.revisions: new immutable registration with parent hash; preserve all earlier receipts and consumption
freeze.final_registration_hash_storage: record the final file byte SHA256 in an external immutable receipt or sidecar, never recursively inside its own byte-hashed content
required_before_candidate_freeze: rho=.01 and both exact FP32 16-head scale vectors bound to actual observation
accepted native leaf-Delta TP policy receipt bound to the same numerical forward path
all optimizer and writer-FD numerical settings and sample order fixed
authoritative ledger plus complete remaining reservations fits both caps

leaf_TP_fd_attempt_1.reason: analytic grad-enabled versus no-grad baseline numerical path differed; no TP policy was accepted

leaf_TP_fd_attempt_2.reason: Same-grad-mode baseline replay matched, but no accepted FD-to-autograd scaling policy was established.

evidence_verification_scope.token_cache_sha256_provenance: expected value from verified sealed manifest; actual token-cache bytes must be rehashed by remote runner before use
evidence_verification_scope.model_weights_receipt_sha256_provenance: reference recorded in locally hashed native preflight receipt; full weights not read by this registration task
runtime_preflight_scope: No writer parameter, writer update, BPTT, TP writer reduction, or resume was tested.
Nonzero leaf-delta gradients do not establish a writer gradient scaling rule.
Tiny synthetic inputs do not establish full-length memory or throughput capacity.
evidence_verification_scope.writer_initial_parameters_sha256_provena: reference in hashed observation COMPLETE artifact list; writer_initial_state.pt was not included in this local compact receipt export
evidence_verification_scope.observation_frame_scope: 18 history-only frames for 12 training/calibration samples; not the complete 24-sample query/history frame manifest
evidence_verification_scope.writer_initial_parameters_hash_contract: SHA256 of observation writer_initial_state.pt FILE BYTES with seed17 parameters and unit target_scale. Runner verifies this file, loads it, then applies the fixed mode-specific scale; later tensor-state checkpoint hashes are separate.

allowed_actions: the registered six-family initial perturbation check
the registered full-writer BPTT finite-difference check
write immutable pass/failure receipts and final registration

requires: accepted leaf-TP scaling policy bound to identical numerical runtime
immutable final registration containing all parent and diagnostic receipt hashes

FAILED_DIAGNOSTIC.action: preserve all receipts and consumed targets; no parameter search or unregistered retry

conditional_execution_scope: Root-authorized single-process transition from fully bound candidate through fixed diagnostics to immutable executable registration; no human reapproval is needed for an already authorized PASS transition.

writer_BPTT_finite_difference.query: second article first 128 tokens with local BOS=248044
writer_BPTT_finite_difference.direction: first analytic full-trajectory gradient over all trainable writer parameters, concatenate in named_parameters order on TP0, normalize to unit L2 and broadcast exactly to writer TP replicas; no parameter update
writer_BPTT_finite_difference.absolute_step_formula: relative_step * initial L2 norm of all trainable writer parameters, excluding buffers
writer_BPTT_finite_difference.pair_selection: in increasing h order, take the first adjacent pair with both eligible and abs(D_right-D_left)<=atol+rtol*abs(D_left); never consult autograd to select the pair
writer_BPTT_finite_difference.gradient_acceptance: both selected slopes must satisfy abs(dot(g,v)-D)<=atol+rtol*abs(D)
writer_BPTT_finite_difference.post_call_restore: restore exact initial writer parameters and verify checksum; no FD state survives into initial arms
writer_BPTT_finite_difference.failure_action: inconclusive or failed diagnostic; prohibit optimizer, preserve target charges, no changed direction/epsilon/tolerance search
writer_BPTT_finite_difference.limits: one direction in one registered alpha/norm condition tests this shared writer/reader chain; it is not exhaustive all-arm gradient validation or a performance test
